description: Dialog editor of one table cell (Fáze 9): text, link, column and row span, alignment, background colour and the header flag of its row, with a mini preview of the whole table in which the edited cell is highlighted. Reachable from every cell of the inline table grid, in both item editing modes.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: The table whose cell is edited.

parameters.name: RowIndex
parameters.description: The row of the edited cell.

parameters.name: CellIndex
parameters.description: The column of the edited cell.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the dialog read-only; Save is disabled and the copy can never be applied.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised after the copy was applied to the table (one change, one undo step).

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised when the user closes the dialog without applying the copy.
